review_description: About 10% cheaper than a local supplier - and Zasco had to come up from Perth. Got a premium system with micro-inverters.Service and advice excellent both in the lead up to, and after, installation. Scott and Kirsten were both fantastic.You should negotiate with them to get them registered as installers for your brand.
Did not have pre installation site inspection. Probably cost installer money as was more difficult than expected.
The installation was quick and efficient. Colin was exceptionally helpful.
